findings.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
findings.summary_md: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities and suspended the Cloud Backup service (formerly SkyKick) on October 17, 2026, after attackers compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. The vendor revoked certificates used for affected application connections. The action followed unauthorized access to application identities within the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment.

findings.title: ConnectWise (SkyKick) Vendor Credentials Abused in M365 Attacks - Huntress
findings.summary_md: Huntress confirmed a compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup API secret (formerly SkyKick) was used to gain unauthorized access to customer Microsoft 365 tenants. The credential abuse began around October 14-15, 2026, with unauthorized sign-ins confirmed across 173 M365 partner and customer tenants by October 17, 2026. Huntress published technical details and IOCs for defenders.

findings.title: ConnectWise Trust Center Advisory - Application Identity Compromise
findings.summary_md: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities at 07:00 UTC on October 17, 2026, and revoked certificates for affected connections. The advisory notes that since implementing mitigations the vendor has not observed successful threat activity in monitored environments. Technical guidance includes the disabled identities and recommendations for reviewing M365 sign-in logs.
